      6. ACO ShowerDrain B

      ACO ShowerDrain B – channelbody and gratings

      Product benefits

      • All-in-one package: channel, grating & gully as a ready-to-install set
      • Flexible for any installation situation: 360° rotatable drain trap
      • Secure sealing: factory-made sealing membrane
      • Meets the highest water exposure class W3-I in accordance with DIN 18534
      • Easy cleaning: free access to the pipeline

      Product information

      • Material:
        • Channel body: stainless steel
        • Gully element: Plastic
      • Product class A (DIN EN 1253)
      • Load class K3 (DIN EN 1253)
      • Assembly: ready to install
      • Flange: permanently moulded on stainless steel flange and factory-made sealing membrane
      • Visible width: 70 mm
      • Tile frame height: 12 mm
      • Installation height: 80 mm to top edge of screed
      • Socket design: DN50 (suitable for all plug-in pipe socket systems)
      • Discharge capacity with 30 mm seal water level (DIN EN 1253-6):
        • 0.4 l/s with 10 mm build-up
        • 0.46 l/s with 20 mm build-up
      • Optional accessories:
        • Mounting angle incl. sound insulation accessories
        • ShowerStep difference wedge
